scope: Additive Fireball L1-27 Grand Warden active projectile audit; permanent Equipment effect is separated from its temporary 2024 acquisition event.
game_version: Official March, April and June 2024 Fireball changes and January 2025 radius change; dated secondary claimed client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Super Dragon Spotlight
facts: The Grand Warden's Epic active Fireball shoots at the nearest Defense and damages a large area around it.
The launch L1-27 table lists Warden DPS, projectile damage, area tiles and ore costs.
sources.limitations: The launch radius progression predates the 2025 rebalance; the temporary event economy and event battlefield content are excluded. No projectile speed, firing delay, distance metric or impact footprint rule is given.

sources.title: Temperamental Tentacles Update!
facts: Fireball damage now affects both ground and air regardless of what it aims at; earlier same-layer-only behavior was fixed.
sources.limitations: Does not define whether the splash includes every ground/air entity class, collision geometry or damage tick.

sources.title: June Update: Full Patch Notes
facts: Equipment initial target selection was changed to take building size into account instead of only a building midpoint; Fireball, Seeking Shield and Spiky Ball are named examples.
sources.limitations: No exact footprint-distance formula, search radius, target eligibility, entity-ID tie or occlusion rule is provided.

sources.title: Hero Equipment Balance Changes!
facts: The last Fireball radius upgrade moved to a higher Equipment level.
sources.limitations: The article does not state the new threshold or exact current radius at each level.

sources.title: Fireball — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: Dated table confirms L1-27 Warden DPS 21-101, ore costs and a closest-Defense explosion description.
sources.limitations: It does not list current projectile damage, splash radius, target geometry or travel/impact timing.

sources.title: Pinned Fireball Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: Pinned L1-27 projectileDamage is 1500-4100; damageRadius is 4 tiles at L1-8, 5 tiles at L9-23 and 6 tiles at L24-27.
Warden DPS bonus reaches 101 at L27.
sources.limitations: The payload omits firing/travel timing, target-size metric, splash footprint and current effect continuity.

observations.note: The launch table had 6 tiles already at L18, but the pinned series moves that step to L24, consistent with the later official radius change. Exact post-change level mapping is secondary sourced only.

derivations.result: Retain pinned area, projectile damage and Warden DPS fields as catalogue data
derivations.method: Compare the March 2024 launch table, January 2025 change statement, pinned raw series and dated 2026 Warden DPS/cost table without importing obsolete launch radii.

derivations.result: Record nearest Defense initial selection with building size considered and ground/air splash
derivations.method: Read the March and June 2024 official notes together with the April 2024 target-layer bug fix; leave the distance and impact formulas open.

rejected_inferences.rule: Choose the nearest Defense by center-to-center Euclidean distance
rejected_inferences.reason: Official June 2024 notes explicitly changed equipment selection to account for building size, without specifying the metric.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use the March 2024 launch radius 6 tiles at L18-23 as current
rejected_inferences.reason: The January 2025 radius threshold moved later and the pinned series has 5 tiles through L23.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply explosion damage immediately on ability activation
rejected_inferences.reason: Projectile launch, travel, target loss, impact and simultaneous damage ordering are not specified.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply a 6-tile center-radius circle to every unit and building
rejected_inferences.reason: The area figure does not define origin, hitbox overlap, edge inclusion or class filters.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the 2024 Super Dragon Spotlight temporary event as a battlefield rule
rejected_inferences.reason: The official page separates event acquisition from the permanent Fireball Equipment.

items: current projectile damage and radius continuity after pinned series
nearest Defense footprint metric, origin, search range, eligible defenses and ID ties
launch animation, projectile speed/arc, target loss, impact and same-tick damage order
splash origin, boundary, hitboxes and ground/air unit/building eligibility
damage reduction, immunity, Overgrowth and Earthquake interactions
Warden ground/air mode, death, revival and other Equipment timing
Viewer projectile/art rights/overlay, snapshot, replay and RL activation state

conclusion: Fireball L1-27 remains partial and catalogue-only. Official sources establish active nearest-Defense area damage, building-size-aware initial selection and ground/air splash, but the exact target/impact geometry and timing remain unresolved.
